MASTERED.description: Concept clicked on first explanation AND passed at least one active-recall test. Safe to build upon.

DEVELOPING.description: Understands when explained step-by-step. Can implement from blueprint. Not yet independently verified.

FRAGILE.description: Introduced but not reliably retained. High risk of regression. Needs active recall testing.

UNVERIFIED_HUNCH.description: AI suspects the developer may know this but has never been explicitly tested. Must be probed casually.

usage_note: Seed template for new adopters. The agent auto-populates knowledge states based on session audits.
